correctness.rationale: Exact signed-permutation model is certified with rational interval comparisons. Standalone checker reconstructs 24 vertices, 60 edges, diameter four and all faces; verifies 40 and 662 free-face elementary collapses at radii one and two; certifies connected surface with Euler characteristic two at radius two; constructs 18399 matched pairs over all 36804 radius-three faces with critical cells one 0-cell and five 5-cells, then independently verifies the global gradient digraph is acyclic by a full topological sort. Morse CW has no intermediate cells, so it is a wedge of five 5-spheres, not merely a homology computation. Boundary ranges r>=0 and integer inclusion thresholds are explicit. No results about symmetry representations or unseen scales are inferred.

value.rationale: The snub cube is the canonical chiral Archimedean solid not treated by the 2023 classification of Platonic-solid Rips complexes. Its complete graph-metric filtration resolves the first through last metric thresholds and exhibits successive nontrivial homotopy in degrees 1, 2, and 5, including a 36804-face radius-three stage collapsing in Morse theory to five 5-spheres. This supplies a natural whole-object benchmark and explicit independently repeatable acyclicity certificate; it is not a new notation, a one-cell arithmetic gain, or an arbitrary slice.
